guides.description: What Long COVID is, why existing medicines are being studied, and what the prevention and treatment trials found.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Long COVID can involve persistent or recurring fatigue, problems with thinking, breathlessness and worsening symptoms after physical or mental effort. Symptoms can affect several body systems and continue for months or years. Repurposing studies ask two different questions: whether treatment during acute infection reduces later illness, and whether treatment helps people who already have persistent symptoms.

sentences.text: Long COVID can involve persistent or recurring fatigue, problems with thinking, breathlessness and worsening symptoms after physical or mental effort. Symptoms can affect several body systems and continue for months or years.
Repurposing studies ask two different questions: whether treatment during acute infection reduces later illness, and whether treatment helps people who already have persistent symptoms.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Metformin prevention studies produced different results across outcomes, while the cited metformin and nirmatrelvir–ritonavir trials did not demonstrate their expected primary treatment benefit in established Long COVID.

sentences.text: Metformin prevention studies produced different results across outcomes, while the cited metformin and nirmatrelvir–ritonavir trials did not demonstrate their expected primary treatment benefit in established Long COVID.

questions.question: Does starting metformin during COVID-19 prevent Long COVID?
questions.answer: COVID-OUT reported a prevention signal, but the report has a correction notice and conflicting control percentages. ACTIV-6 did not meet its prespecified threshold for the primary long-term symptom outcome.

sentences.text: COVID-OUT reported a prevention signal, but the report has a correction notice and conflicting control percentages. ACTIV-6 did not meet its prespecified threshold for the primary long-term symptom outcome.

questions.question: Do these medicines help established Long COVID?
questions.answer: The South Korean metformin trial did not find improved recovery after the tested short course. STOP-PASC and RECOVER-VITAL did not show their expected primary benefit from nirmatrelvir–ritonavir in the studied symptom groups.

sentences.text: The South Korean metformin trial did not find improved recovery after the tested short course. STOP-PASC and RECOVER-VITAL did not show their expected primary benefit from nirmatrelvir–ritonavir in the studied symptom groups.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: STOP-PASC excluded some people because of drug interactions and other eligibility criteria. Those restrictions matter when considering its tolerability findings; ritonavir can substantially change exposure to other medicines. Metformin can cause gastrointestinal symptoms and has kidney-function restrictions relevant to lactic-acidosis risk.

sections.paragraph: These trials did not directly compare metformin with nirmatrelvir–ritonavir for the same population and outcome. Prevention during infection, recovery after established illness and improvement in particular symptoms are separate comparisons.

faqs.answer: Yes. Post-exertional worsening can follow physical or mental effort and is one of the symptoms described by CDC. The effect of a treatment on that symptom should be measured explicitly.

guides.description: Repurposed medicines in acute COVID-19: antiviral treatment, inflammatory pathways and randomized results.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Acute COVID-19 is the illness caused by a current SARS-CoV-2 infection. Its course ranges from mild respiratory symptoms to severe illness, with older age and certain medical conditions increasing risk. Drug studies have tested ways to reduce viral replication or the harmful host response before illness progresses.

sentences.text: Acute COVID-19 is the illness caused by a current SARS-CoV-2 infection. Its course ranges from mild respiratory symptoms to severe illness, with older age and certain medical conditions increasing risk.
Drug studies have tested ways to reduce viral replication or the harmful host response before illness progresses.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: The COVID-OUT trial tested metformin, ivermectin and fluvoxamine in adults with overweight or obesity. None significantly reduced its primary composite of hypoxaemia, emergency care, hospitalization or death. Nirmatrelvir with ritonavir has a separate established role in early treatment of eligible people at higher risk of severe COVID-19.

sentences.text: The COVID-OUT trial tested metformin, ivermectin and fluvoxamine in adults with overweight or obesity. None significantly reduced its primary composite of hypoxaemia, emergency care, hospitalization or death.

questions.question: Is an acute COVID-19 result also a Long COVID result?
questions.answer: No. The acute COVID-OUT report measured progression during the infection; the later follow-up asked about clinician-diagnosed Long COVID. Different follow-up periods and endpoints can give different answers.

sentences.text: No. The acute COVID-OUT report measured progression during the infection; the later follow-up asked about clinician-diagnosed Long COVID. Different follow-up periods and endpoints can give different answers.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Ritonavir creates important drug-interaction constraints, and kidney and liver function affect treatment selection. Early antiviral treatment also has a short window from symptom onset.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: Hospitalization prevention in a high-risk group cannot be equated with shortening mild symptoms in a lower-risk group. The COVID-OUT trial and outpatient antiviral recommendations concern different drugs, eligibility criteria and outcomes.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: COVID-OUT was placebo-controlled and enrolled nonhospitalized adults with overweight or obesity. Its primary outcome combined oxygen saturation, emergency care, hospitalization and death; component and later follow-up results answer narrower questions.

guides.description: Epithelial ovarian and fallopian-tube cancers, and the evidence behind itraconazole combinations.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian-tube and primary peritoneal cancers arise in closely related tissues and are treated using overlapping approaches. Histological subtype, stage and prior response to platinum chemotherapy influence the treatment question. Repurposing research includes itraconazole in recurrent ovarian clear cell carcinoma, a specific subtype that can respond poorly to cytotoxic treatment.

sentences.text: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian-tube and primary peritoneal cancers arise in closely related tissues and are treated using overlapping approaches. Histological subtype, stage and prior response to platinum chemotherapy influence the treatment question.
Repurposing research includes itraconazole in recurrent ovarian clear cell carcinoma, a specific subtype that can respond poorly to cytotoxic treatment.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: A retrospective series combined itraconazole with chemotherapy in nine patients with recurrent or persistent clear cell carcinoma. Responses were observed, but all patients received combination treatment and there was no randomized chemotherapy-only group.

sentences.text: A retrospective series combined itraconazole with chemotherapy in nine patients with recurrent or persistent clear cell carcinoma. Responses were observed, but all patients received combination treatment and there was no randomized chemotherapy-only group.

questions.question: Did itraconazole itself produce the tumor responses?
questions.answer: The series cannot separate itraconazole’s contribution from chemotherapy, patient selection or other care. Its findings support a combination-treatment hypothesis rather than a measured advantage attributable to itraconazole alone.

sentences.text: The series cannot separate itraconazole’s contribution from chemotherapy, patient selection or other care. Its findings support a combination-treatment hypothesis rather than a measured advantage attributable to itraconazole alone.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: The study added itraconazole to cytotoxic chemotherapy, so both the chemotherapy regimen and combination tolerability matter. Its small size cannot characterize uncommon toxicity.

sentences.text: The study added itraconazole to cytotoxic chemotherapy, so both the chemotherapy regimen and combination tolerability matter. Its small size cannot characterize uncommon toxicity.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: Surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy form part of established care described by NCI. The itraconazole series did not test replacement of those treatments or compare itraconazole with modern biomarker-directed maintenance therapy.

sentences.text: Surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy form part of established care described by NCI. The itraconazole series did not test replacement of those treatments or compare itraconazole with modern biomarker-directed maintenance therapy.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The nine-patient series reported a 44% response rate, with a wide 95% confidence interval of 12–77%. The retrospective design and concurrent chemotherapy make this a preliminary signal.

sentences.text: The nine-patient series reported a 44% response rate, with a wide 95% confidence interval of 12–77%. The retrospective design and concurrent chemotherapy make this a preliminary signal.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Itraconazole has also been studied in prostate, lung and basal cell cancers, using different combinations and endpoints.

sentences.text: Itraconazole has also been studied in prostate, lung and basal cell cancers, using different combinations and endpoints.

faqs.question: Why are ovarian and fallopian-tube cancers discussed together?
faqs.answer: These epithelial cancers have related biological origins and overlapping staging and treatment approaches. Histology and molecular features still matter within that shared category.

guides.description: Why glioblastoma researchers are testing existing drugs, including mebendazole, alongside standard treatment.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Glioblastoma is an aggressive glioma that infiltrates brain tissue. Treatment commonly combines surgery where feasible with radiation and chemotherapy, but infiltration makes complete removal difficult. Mebendazole, an antiparasitic medicine, has been investigated as an addition to temozolomide in newly diagnosed high-grade gliomas.

sentences.text: Glioblastoma is an aggressive glioma that infiltrates brain tissue. Treatment commonly combines surgery where feasible with radiation and chemotherapy, but infiltration makes complete removal difficult.
Mebendazole, an antiparasitic medicine, has been investigated as an addition to temozolomide in newly diagnosed high-grade gliomas.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: A phase 1 study examined mebendazole with temozolomide, concentrating on dose, exposure and tolerability. The study did not randomize patients against temozolomide alone, so survival observations cannot establish an added survival benefit.

sentences.text: A phase 1 study examined mebendazole with temozolomide, concentrating on dose, exposure and tolerability. The study did not randomize patients against temozolomide alone, so survival observations cannot establish an added survival benefit.

questions.question: Has mebendazole been shown to improve glioblastoma survival?
questions.answer: This phase 1 study did not provide a controlled estimate of survival improvement. It also included high-grade gliomas beyond glioblastoma, making tumor classification important when reading individual outcomes.

sentences.text: This phase 1 study did not provide a controlled estimate of survival improvement. It also included high-grade gliomas beyond glioblastoma, making tumor classification important when reading individual outcomes.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Elevated liver enzymes occurred during treatment in the phase 1 study and could require dose reduction or discontinuation. Safety cannot be inferred from the much shorter regimens used to treat intestinal parasites.

sentences.text: Elevated liver enzymes occurred during treatment in the phase 1 study and could require dose reduction or discontinuation. Safety cannot be inferred from the much shorter regimens used to treat intestinal parasites.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: A dose-escalation study answers a different question from a randomized efficacy trial. Glioblastoma subtype, treatment history and the accompanying chemoradiation must match before survival estimates can be compared.

sentences.text: A dose-escalation study answers a different question from a randomized efficacy trial. Glioblastoma subtype, treatment history and the accompanying chemoradiation must match before survival estimates can be compared.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The phase 1 trial enrolled 24 people with high-grade gliomas, including 18 with glioblastoma. Its central contribution was combination tolerability and pharmacokinetic information.

faqs.answer: Glioblastoma cells can infiltrate surrounding brain tissue beyond the visible tumor. Removing every infiltrating cell may not be feasible without damaging essential brain function.

guides.description: Low-dose naltrexone in fibromyalgia: the pain-processing rationale and the results of a larger placebo-controlled trial.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Fibromyalgia causes widespread pain and tenderness, often with fatigue, unrefreshing sleep and difficulty thinking clearly. Research points to altered pain processing rather than a single damaged joint or muscle. Low-dose naltrexone has been studied as a way to change central pain modulation.

sentences.text: Fibromyalgia causes widespread pain and tenderness, often with fatigue, unrefreshing sleep and difficulty thinking clearly. Research points to altered pain processing rather than a single damaged joint or muscle.
Low-dose naltrexone has been studied as a way to change central pain modulation.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: In a 2024 trial of 99 women, naltrexone did not produce superior pain relief over placebo after 12 weeks. The between-group pain difference was −0.34 points on an 11-point scale, with a 95% confidence interval from −0.95 to 0.27.

sentences.text: In a 2024 trial of 99 women, naltrexone did not produce superior pain relief over placebo after 12 weeks. The between-group pain difference was −0.34 points on an 11-point scale, with a 95% confidence interval from −0.95 to 0.27.

questions.question: Does the trial rule out every possible benefit?
questions.answer: It did not demonstrate the primary pain benefit. Exploratory findings concerning memory or pain modulation address different outcomes and need confirmation rather than being substituted for the pain result.

sentences.text: It did not demonstrate the primary pain benefit. Exploratory findings concerning memory or pain modulation address different outcomes and need confirmation rather than being substituted for the pain result.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Adverse events were reported by 84% of naltrexone recipients and 86% of placebo recipients in the 2024 trial. Four naltrexone recipients and three placebo recipients stopped because of adverse events.

sentences.text: Adverse events were reported by 84% of naltrexone recipients and 86% of placebo recipients in the 2024 trial. Four naltrexone recipients and three placebo recipients stopped because of adverse events.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: Fibromyalgia care commonly combines movement-based approaches, psychological or behavioral treatment and medicines. The naltrexone trial compared the drug with placebo; it did not establish superiority to that broader approach or to another active medicine.

sentences.text: Fibromyalgia care commonly combines movement-based approaches, psychological or behavioral treatment and medicines. The naltrexone trial compared the drug with placebo; it did not establish superiority to that broader approach or to another active medicine.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The pain trial was randomized and double-blind. Its estimate allows both a modest pain benefit and no benefit, but does not support the proposed average superiority over placebo.

faqs.answer: Yes. Sleep problems, fatigue and cognitive symptoms are common. A pain trial does not automatically answer whether a treatment helps these other difficulties.

guides.description: Low-dose naltrexone and ME/CFS: what immune-cell experiments can explain and what they do not measure.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: ME/CFS is a disabling multisystem illness marked by reduced ability to carry out usual activities, unrefreshing sleep and post-exertional malaise. Physical or mental effort can cause a delayed worsening of symptoms. Naltrexone research has examined altered signaling in natural-killer immune cells as one possible treatment target.

sentences.text: ME/CFS is a disabling multisystem illness marked by reduced ability to carry out usual activities, unrefreshing sleep and post-exertional malaise. Physical or mental effort can cause a delayed worsening of symptoms.
Naltrexone research has examined altered signaling in natural-killer immune cells as one possible treatment target.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: The cited naltrexone study investigated TRPM3 ion-channel function in cells from people with ME/CFS. It was not a randomized trial measuring recovery, work capacity or post-exertional malaise.

sentences.text: The cited naltrexone study investigated TRPM3 ion-channel function in cells from people with ME/CFS. It was not a randomized trial measuring recovery, work capacity or post-exertional malaise.

questions.question: Has this research shown that naltrexone restores daily function?
questions.answer: No controlled clinical improvement can be estimated from this cell study. Its finding concerns ion-channel behavior, leaving the size and duration of any effect on daily symptoms unanswered.

sentences.text: No controlled clinical improvement can be estimated from this cell study. Its finding concerns ion-channel behavior, leaving the size and duration of any effect on daily symptoms unanswered.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Post-exertional malaise changes how activity-based outcomes should be interpreted: doing more on one day can be followed by a symptom flare. CDC describes activity management within individual limits to reduce these episodes.

sentences.text: Post-exertional malaise changes how activity-based outcomes should be interpreted: doing more on one day can be followed by a symptom flare. CDC describes activity management within individual limits to reduce these episodes.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: A laboratory comparison of cells cannot be compared numerically with a clinical treatment trial. The practical outcomes for ME/CFS include daily function, cognitive symptoms and post-exertional worsening, not only a cellular signal.

sentences.text: A laboratory comparison of cells cannot be compared numerically with a clinical treatment trial. The practical outcomes for ME/CFS include daily function, cognitive symptoms and post-exertional worsening, not only a cellular signal.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Patient-derived immune cells can test a channel mechanism directly. They cannot measure sleep, sustained activity or the delayed symptom worsening that defines post-exertional malaise.

sentences.text: Patient-derived immune cells can test a channel mechanism directly. They cannot measure sleep, sustained activity or the delayed symptom worsening that defines post-exertional malaise.

sentences.text: The fibromyalgia and Long COVID pages discuss overlapping symptoms in distinct populations; shared fatigue does not make the diagnoses or endpoints identical.

faqs.answer: Post-exertional malaise can be delayed after activity. Following symptoms over subsequent days can capture deterioration that is not obvious during the activity itself.

guides.description: Naltrexone for compulsive sexual behavior disorder: effects on urges, trial outcomes and tolerability.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Compulsive sexual behavior disorder involves persistent difficulty controlling repetitive sexual behavior that causes marked distress or impairment. The treatment question concerns control and consequences, rather than the frequency of sexual desire alone. Naltrexone has been investigated because opioid-receptor blockade may reduce the rewarding or urge-driven component of behavior.

sentences.text: Compulsive sexual behavior disorder involves persistent difficulty controlling repetitive sexual behavior that causes marked distress or impairment. The treatment question concerns control and consequences, rather than the frequency of sexual desire alone.
Naltrexone has been investigated because opioid-receptor blockade may reduce the rewarding or urge-driven component of behavior.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: A randomized study of 73 men compared naltrexone, paroxetine and placebo. Self-report symptom improvement did not clearly separate the groups, while clinical interviews favored active treatment on some behavioral outcomes.

sentences.text: A randomized study of 73 men compared naltrexone, paroxetine and placebo. Self-report symptom improvement did not clearly separate the groups, while clinical interviews favored active treatment on some behavioral outcomes.

sentences.text: In the feasibility study, commonly reported effects included fatigue, nausea, vertigo and abdominal pain. Tolerability findings from twenty men cannot determine risks for all patient groups.

guides.description: Persistent genital arousal and genitopelvic dysesthesia: sensory mechanisms and why evidence from compulsive behavior does not transfer.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: PGAD/genitopelvic dysesthesia involves unwanted genital arousal sensations that persist or recur without corresponding sexual desire. Symptoms can be distressing and are not evidence of unusually high libido. Neurological studies investigate sensory signaling from the genital area, pelvis and sacral nerves, rather than assuming a single psychological or behavioral cause.

sentences.text: PGAD/genitopelvic dysesthesia involves unwanted genital arousal sensations that persist or recur without corresponding sexual desire. Symptoms can be distressing and are not evidence of unusually high libido.
Neurological studies investigate sensory signaling from the genital area, pelvis and sacral nerves, rather than assuming a single psychological or behavioral cause.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: The cited studies characterize symptoms and possible causes; they do not establish naltrexone as an effective PGAD treatment. Its trials in compulsive sexual behavior studied a different condition.

sentences.text: The cited studies characterize symptoms and possible causes; they do not establish naltrexone as an effective PGAD treatment. Its trials in compulsive sexual behavior studied a different condition.

questions.question: Does benefit for compulsive behavior establish benefit for PGAD?
questions.answer: No. Reducing repetitive behavior or urges does not show that a medicine relieves unwanted sensory arousal. A PGAD study needs to measure the sensations, distress and functional effects in people with PGAD.

sentences.text: No. Reducing repetitive behavior or urges does not show that a medicine relieves unwanted sensory arousal. A PGAD study needs to measure the sensations, distress and functional effects in people with PGAD.

sections.label: Safety

sentences.text: The neurological series included cases associated with medication effects and underlying nerve or spinal pathology. A medicine history and evaluation of accompanying neurological symptoms can therefore change the explanation of symptoms.

sections.label: Comparisons

sentences.text: PGAD and CSBD should be distinguished in research comparisons: one centers on unwanted physical sensation, the other on impaired control of behavior. Combining them would obscure whether a treatment helps the symptom that brought a person to care.

sections.label: Evidence

sentences.text: The neurological case series and the iPGAD case-control study investigate causes and clinical features. Neither design supplies a randomized estimate of naltrexone’s effect on PGAD symptoms.

sentences.text: The CSBD page covers naltrexone research on repetitive behavior, making the difference in symptom targets explicit.

guides.description: Pramipexole augmentation for treatment-resistant depression, including the dopamine rationale and randomized trial evidence.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Treatment-resistant depression describes continuing depressive illness despite adequate treatment attempts. Its symptoms can include loss of pleasure, motivation and daily function as well as persistent low mood. Pramipexole, originally used for movement disorders, has been studied as an addition to existing antidepressants.

sentences.text: Treatment-resistant depression describes continuing depressive illness despite adequate treatment attempts. Its symptoms can include loss of pleasure, motivation and daily function as well as persistent low mood.
Pramipexole, originally used for movement disorders, has been studied as an addition to existing antidepressants.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: The 2025 PAX-D trial found a greater reduction in depressive symptoms with pramipexole augmentation than placebo at 12 weeks. The benefit came with adverse effects, making both symptom change and tolerability relevant.

sentences.text: The 2025 PAX-D trial found a greater reduction in depressive symptoms with pramipexole augmentation than placebo at 12 weeks. The benefit came with adverse effects, making both symptom change and tolerability relevant.

questions.question: Was pramipexole tested as a replacement for antidepressants?
questions.answer: No. PAX-D tested it as an add-on in treatment-resistant unipolar depression. Its result does not directly answer whether pramipexole alone is effective or whether the same balance applies to bipolar depression.

sentences.text: No. PAX-D tested it as an add-on in treatment-resistant unipolar depression. Its result does not directly answer whether pramipexole alone is effective or whether the same balance applies to bipolar depression.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Treatment stopped because of adverse events in 20% with pramipexole versus 5% with placebo. Reported effects included nausea, headache, disturbed sleep and somnolence.

sentences.text: Treatment stopped because of adverse events in 20% with pramipexole versus 5% with placebo. Reported effects included nausea, headache, disturbed sleep and somnolence.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: PAX-D provides a placebo comparison for an augmentation strategy in unipolar depression. It was not a head-to-head comparison with ketamine, electroconvulsive therapy or another augmentation medicine.

sentences.text: PAX-D provides a placebo comparison for an augmentation strategy in unipolar depression. It was not a head-to-head comparison with ketamine, electroconvulsive therapy or another augmentation medicine.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The primary PAX-D outcome was depressive-symptom change at 12 weeks. The adjusted between-group difference was −3.91 QIDS-SR points (95% CI −5.37 to −2.45).

sentences.text: The primary PAX-D outcome was depressive-symptom change at 12 weeks. The adjusted between-group difference was −3.91 QIDS-SR points (95% CI −5.37 to −2.45).

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The pramipexole profile explains dopamine-receptor activity and the distinction between its movement-disorder use and antidepressant augmentation.

sentences.text: The pramipexole profile explains dopamine-receptor activity and the distinction between its movement-disorder use and antidepressant augmentation.

faqs.question: Is loss of pleasure relevant to depression research?
faqs.answer: Yes. Loss of interest or enjoyment is a core depressive symptom, and dopamine-focused research has specifically examined reward and motivation.

sentences.text: Yes. Loss of interest or enjoyment is a core depressive symptom, and dopamine-focused research has specifically examined reward and motivation.

guides.description: Doxycycline as a periodontal host-response treatment, and how its benefit differs from dental cleaning or antibiotic dosing.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Periodontitis involves inflammation and destruction of the tissues and bone that support teeth. Bacterial plaque initiates the problem, while the body’s inflammatory response contributes to tissue damage. Doxycycline has been repurposed at subantimicrobial exposure to inhibit tissue-degrading enzymes, alongside mechanical periodontal treatment.

sentences.text: Periodontitis involves inflammation and destruction of the tissues and bone that support teeth. Bacterial plaque initiates the problem, while the body’s inflammatory response contributes to tissue damage.
Doxycycline has been repurposed at subantimicrobial exposure to inhibit tissue-degrading enzymes, alongside mechanical periodontal treatment.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: A multicenter trial found greater improvements in attachment level and periodontal pocket depth when subantimicrobial-dose doxycycline was added to scaling and root planing than with cleaning plus placebo.

sentences.text: A multicenter trial found greater improvements in attachment level and periodontal pocket depth when subantimicrobial-dose doxycycline was added to scaling and root planing than with cleaning plus placebo.

questions.question: Does doxycycline replace scaling and root planing?
questions.answer: No. The trial tested an adjunct to mechanical treatment. Its result concerns the additional effect of the medicine when both groups received periodontal cleaning.

sentences.text: No. The trial tested an adjunct to mechanical treatment. Its result concerns the additional effect of the medicine when both groups received periodontal cleaning.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: The periodontal trial followed patients receiving the medicine alongside dental treatment. Smoking and uncontrolled local plaque remain important influences on healing and disease progression, regardless of the adjunct chosen.

sentences.text: The periodontal trial followed patients receiving the medicine alongside dental treatment. Smoking and uncontrolled local plaque remain important influences on healing and disease progression, regardless of the adjunct chosen.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: Attachment gain and pocket-depth change are periodontal outcomes; they are not interchangeable with immediate pain relief or removal of plaque. The useful comparison is the same dental care with or without the adjunct.

sentences.text: Attachment gain and pocket-depth change are periodontal outcomes; they are not interchangeable with immediate pain relief or removal of plaque. The useful comparison is the same dental care with or without the adjunct.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The multicenter study analyzed 209 patients over nine months. Clinical attachment level and probing depth measure the supporting tissues and periodontal pockets, not eradication of all oral bacteria.

sentences.text: The multicenter study analyzed 209 patients over nine months. Clinical attachment level and probing depth measure the supporting tissues and periodontal pockets, not eradication of all oral bacteria.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The doxycycline profile follows its host-enzyme action, separate from its antibacterial uses.

sentences.text: The doxycycline profile follows its host-enzyme action, separate from its antibacterial uses.

faqs.question: Can periodontitis affect tooth support?
faqs.answer: Yes. The disease damages the tissues and bone that hold teeth in place. That is why attachment level and pocket depth are relevant treatment measurements.

sentences.text: Yes. The disease damages the tissues and bone that hold teeth in place. That is why attachment level and pocket depth are relevant treatment measurements.

guides.description: How molecular profiles in Crohn’s disease are being used to identify new treatment candidates.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Crohn’s disease causes chronic inflammation in the digestive tract, with symptoms such as diarrhea, abdominal pain and weight loss. Treatment aims to control inflammation and maintain remission.

sentences.text: Crohn’s disease causes chronic inflammation in the digestive tract, with symptoms such as diarrhea, abdominal pain and weight loss. Treatment aims to control inflammation and maintain remission.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Repurposing research has used gene-expression patterns from people whose Crohn’s disease did not respond to anti-TNF treatment to nominate vorinostat and clomipramine. These are computational candidates; the analysis did not test symptom improvement or remission after taking either drug.

sentences.text: Repurposing research has used gene-expression patterns from people whose Crohn’s disease did not respond to anti-TNF treatment to nominate vorinostat and clomipramine. questions.question: What benefit was actually investigated?
questions.answer: The study looked for drugs that might reverse abnormal gene-expression patterns in two patient clusters. It identified candidates for experimental testing, rather than measuring a clinical treatment effect.

sentences.text: The study looked for drugs that might reverse abnormal gene-expression patterns in two patient clusters. It identified candidates for experimental testing, rather than measuring a clinical treatment effect.

sections.label: Safety

sections.label: Comparisons

sentences.text: Vorinostat and clomipramine were nominated for different molecular clusters. The study did not compare them with one another or with an effective Crohn’s therapy.

sentences.text: Vorinostat and clomipramine were nominated for different molecular clusters in the same Crohn’s analysis.

guides.description: Valproic acid investigations in head and neck squamous cell cancer, including the toxicity that limited clinical testing.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Head and neck squamous cell cancers arise in the surface lining of sites such as the mouth, throat and larynx. Tobacco, alcohol and, for some sites, high-risk HPV infection contribute to risk.

sentences.text: Head and neck squamous cell cancers arise in the surface lining of sites such as the mouth, throat and larynx. Tobacco, alcohol and, for some sites, high-risk HPV infection contribute to risk.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Valproic acid was investigated as an addition to cisplatin-based chemoradiation. Although tumor responses occurred, unacceptable toxicity limited this combination study.

sentences.text: Valproic acid was investigated as an addition to cisplatin-based chemoradiation. Although tumor responses occurred, unacceptable toxicity limited this combination study.

questions.question: Did adding valproic acid establish a better treatment?
questions.answer: No comparative improvement was established. The phase II study was curtailed because toxicity, particularly bone-marrow toxicity and infection, made the regimen difficult to deliver.

sentences.text: No comparative improvement was established. The phase II study was curtailed because toxicity, particularly bone-marrow toxicity and infection, made the regimen difficult to deliver.

sections.label: Safety

sentences.text: Marrow suppression and infections were central safety problems in the combination study. Safety observed when valproic acid is used for another indication cannot substitute for safety of this chemotherapy combination.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: This investigation concerns adding valproic acid to cisplatin and radiation; it does not show that valproic acid can replace either treatment.

sentences.text: This investigation concerns adding valproic acid to cisplatin and radiation; it does not show that valproic acid can replace either treatment.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The clinical combination study could not establish a favorable benefit–harm balance because toxicity constrained delivery. The earlier cell findings answer sensitivity questions, not survival.

sentences.text: The clinical combination study could not establish a favorable benefit–harm balance because toxicity constrained delivery. The earlier cell findings answer sensitivity questions, not survival.

sentences.text: The valproic acid profile and AML page cover related gene-regulation hypotheses tested in different cancer settings.

faqs.question: Are all head and neck tumors the same disease?
faqs.answer: No. Site, cell type and risk factors differ. Most cancers in this group arise in the squamous lining, but an intervention studied in one setting does not cover every head and neck tumor.

sentences.text: No. Site, cell type and risk factors differ. Most cancers in this group arise in the squamous lining, but an intervention studied in one setting does not cover every head and neck tumor.

guides.description: Itraconazole research in advanced prostate cancer, with separate PSA and disease-progression outcomes.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Prostate cancer begins in the prostate gland. The itraconazole investigation focused on metastatic cancer progressing despite testosterone-lowering treatment, a specific advanced-disease setting.

sentences.text: Prostate cancer begins in the prostate gland. The itraconazole investigation focused on metastatic cancer progressing despite testosterone-lowering treatment, a specific advanced-disease setting.

sections.label: Options

sentences.text: A 46-man study found modest activity at the higher itraconazole dose. It compared two dose groups without a standard-treatment control, so it cannot show superiority to established prostate-cancer therapy.

sections.label: Comparisons

sections.label: Evidence

guides.description: Itraconazole added to pemetrexed in a small trial of advanced nonsquamous lung cancer.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Non-small cell lung cancer includes several types, particularly adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. The pemetrexed–itraconazole trial enrolled the nonsquamous subgroup with metastatic disease.

sentences.text: Non-small cell lung cancer includes several types, particularly adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. The pemetrexed–itraconazole trial enrolled the nonsquamous subgroup with metastatic disease.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Adding itraconazole to pemetrexed produced encouraging survival estimates in a trial that enrolled only 23 people before stopping early. The small sample makes those estimates uncertain.

sentences.text: Adding itraconazole to pemetrexed produced encouraging survival estimates in a trial that enrolled only 23 people before stopping early. The small sample makes those estimates uncertain.

sentences.text: Median progression-free survival was 5.5 months with the combination and 2.8 months with pemetrexed alone; the difference did not reach conventional statistical significance (P=0.089).

sentences.text: The study’s small enrollment limits detection of uncommon harms from adding itraconazole to chemotherapy.

sections.label: Comparisons

sentences.text: Median overall survival was 32 versus 8 months, but this was a small, prematurely closed phase II study. It did not compare the combination with modern molecularly targeted or immunotherapy regimens.

sections.label: Evidence

sentences.text: Early closure followed changing use of pemetrexed in lung-cancer care. With only 23 participants, the trial was too small for stable efficacy estimates.

sections.label: Connections

sentences.text: The itraconazole profile compares its antifungal action with cancer-related angiogenesis and Hedgehog hypotheses.

faqs.question: Is nonsquamous disease the whole NSCLC category?

guides.description: Metformin’s metabolic rationale and the negative disease-free-survival result of the MA.32 breast-cancer trial.

sections.label: Overview

sentences.text: Breast cancer arises in breast tissue and includes tumors with different hormone-receptor and HER2 characteristics. Repurposing research has asked whether changing insulin and metabolism can improve outcomes alongside standard cancer care.

sections.label: Options

sentences.text: The large MA.32 trial did not show an invasive disease-free-survival benefit from adding metformin to standard therapy in people without diabetes who had high-risk, operable breast cancer.

guides.description: Aspirin after surgery for colorectal cancers with selected PI3K-pathway alterations.

sentences.text: Colorectal cancer begins in the colon or rectum. ALASCCA studied whether aspirin could reduce recurrence after surgery in localized cancers with selected PI3K-pathway gene alterations.

guides.description: Why metformin was tested in advanced pancreatic cancer and why the randomized result was negative.

guides.description: Propranolol as an experimental addition to immune checkpoint treatment in melanoma.

guides.description: Metformin studies of walking speed and muscle adaptation in older adults.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Sarcopenia involves declining muscle strength and function, often with reduced muscle mass. Difficulty rising from a chair, slower walking and increased falls can threaten independence. Resistance activity and adequate nutrition are central to preserving muscle health.

sentences.text: Sarcopenia involves declining muscle strength and function, often with reduced muscle mass. Difficulty rising from a chair, slower walking and increased falls can threaten independence. Resistance activity and adequate nutrition are central to preserving muscle health.

sections.label: Options

sentences.text: Metformin did not improve walking speed in MET-PREVENT. A separate resistance-training trial found smaller gains in muscle size with metformin, challenging the idea that a diabetes drug necessarily improves muscle aging.

questions.question: What did MET-PREVENT find?

sections.label: Safety
